newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-FEYENOORD EYE CSKA MOSCOW'S SEMAK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FEYENOORD EYE CSKA MOSCOW'S SEMAK.

text.p: Dutch club Feyenoord are close to signing 20-year-old CSKA Moscow midfielder Sergei Semak, but a deal may fall through if the Russian club demands a high transfer fee, Dutch ANP news agency said on Thursday.
Feyenoord coach Arie Haan had recently told reporters he hoped soon to announce a foreign buy. The Dutch side beat CSKA Moscow in the first round of this season's UEFA Cup.
Haan told ANP that personal details had been agreed with Semak's agents but CSKA was demanding too high a fee.
"I'm afraid the deal might not now go ahead," he said. "We've not heard from the Russians for a few days, which is always bad news."
Haan said he would not be pressured into over-spending on Semak. "We could spend that money better elsewhere," he said.

The Rotterdam club has an option on FC Twente midfielder Paul Bosvelt, who may join Feyenoord at the end of the season on a three-year contract, ANP said. The Enschede club has ruled out a mid-season move.
